answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the timber graph. Re-attestations are stored in kernel and zephyr lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2804 identities would post 4900 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
